`DARKANGEL_OLLAMA_MODEL`, set in `deploy/portainer-stack.yml`) to summarize it,
then stores the answer in the file's `summary`, shown under its name on the
Files page. Text and Markdown are sent as text (the first 32 K characters);
PDF, DOCX and XLSX have their text extracted first; images, and 4 stills taken
through a video, go to the model as pictures (ffmpeg, in the image). Videos
are judged on pictures only -- no sound. It runs after the upload has
returned, so it shows on a reload a few seconds to a minute later. Documents
and images over 50 MB, other binaries, and an unreachable Ollama leave it
blank. Unset URL = off.
